violations.explanation: The selected category is indicated only visually (triangle indicator and text color). The Semantics widget does not set 'selected: isSelected', so screen reader users cannot tell which category is currently selected.
Selection state is communicated only through a painted triangle and a change in text opacity, with no semantic equivalent exposed to assistive technologies.
Unselected text uses brown at 60% opacity, which may not reach a 4.5:1 contrast ratio depending on the background (likely Shrine pink). The background is not shown, so this cannot be confirmed.

The Semantics wrapper marks the item as a button but provides no onTap handler. The GestureDetector's tap may not be reliably exposed as a semantic action. Using an InkWell/TextButton, or adding onTap to Semantics, would ensure assistive technologies can activate the item.
